channel.title: Antiques Road Trip
channel.desc: It's a cosmopolitan end to dapper duo Izzie Balmer and Mark Hill's trip as they sweep along the Sussex coast in search of treasures. Izzie is dazzled by a vast haul of Chinese kites, while Mark hopes that an out-of-fashion etching could be an auction sleeper. They pause their shopping in vibrant Brighton to help make a kora, the traditional instrument of west African storytellers, before hearing a maestro perform. But with the final auction looming, who will hit all the right notes?
